en.title: This Animal Gave the Word 'Gecko' Its Name
en.description: This is the tokay gecko. Its name comes from the male's loud 'tokay' call, and the word 'gecko' itself ultimately derives from names for this species. Large males can bite hard enough to pierce skin and draw blood.
